name: stacked-deck
title: Stacked Deck
description: Cards stick one after another and stack like a deck; covered cards step back and dim, leaving their titles as a table of contents.

meta.reducedMotion: Cards stack with sticky positioning but don't scale or dim.
meta.useWhen: Sequences, case studies, steps and services with 3–6 items.
meta.avoidWhen: More than 6 cards; cards taller than the viewport; content that must be compared side by side.
